# The Well, from DNSC

> Free tools for the community from DNSC (Dustin Nimmo Strategic Consulting, West Chester, Ohio): civic tools that follow public money and public law from the record with every source linked, games that teach the vocabulary and the news of AI, practices that hold the day, and teaching for working with AI. Every page has a plain text twin at index.md beside it.

Start at the landing page as text: [The Well](https://tools.dnsc.ai/ai.md). Teaching: https://dnsc.ai/teaching · The open method: https://github.com/theDTrain84/mise-en-place

## Civic tools

- [A Holiday for the Holidays · Ohio's Gas Tax Holiday](https://tools.dnsc.ai/gas-tax/index.md): Ohio's 38.5¢ gas tax is off every gallon for 90 days. Set your tank, see what you save, then follow the oil from the pump to the barrel.
- [Issue 2, in Plain Numbers](https://tools.dnsc.ai/follow-the-money/index.md): What the November school bond means for your tax bill, with every number sourced from the public record.
- [What's in the jar · Cannabis in Ohio](https://tools.dnsc.ai/cannabis/index.md): How strong today's cannabis is, what Ohio's law allows, where the money goes, and what the research says, in plain numbers with every source linked.

## Weekly

- [Word for Word around the world](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/word-for-word-2026-10-20/index.md): Trump, Macron, Merz, Burnham, Carney, Milanović and Putin, in their own words, on a sanctions document on Russia, Saturday's demonstrations and fuel prices, trade protection, power inside Scotland, Alberta's referendum, chants before a football match and a security zone inside Ukraine along the Russian border.
- [Word for Word around the world](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/word-for-word-2026-10-13/index.md): Trump, Macron, Burnham, Erdoğan, Ramaphosa and Tusk, in their own words, on Iran and the midterm elections, the spirit of defeat, immigrants and Europe, international law, the Nobel Peace Prize and Russia's responsibility for the war in Ukraine.
- [Word for Word around the world](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/word-for-word-2026-10-06/index.md): Trump, Putin, Zelenskyy, Netanyahu, Xi, Modi and Lula, in their own words, on Iran, Kaliningrad, negotiations, a cockpit attack, the Chinese nation, peace and a runoff.

## Games and practices

- [The Sunday Edition](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/sunday-edition/index.md): The week in AI as one big crossword, with what's coming next week. New every Sunday at 6 PM.
- [One Word Advanced](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/one-word-advanced/index.md): Seven letters, seven tries. For the word people.
- [The Daily Line](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/daily-line/index.md): One small crossword on the words of AI.
- [The Morning Edition](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/morning-edition/index.md): Yesterday's AI news, as a crossword.
- [One Word](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/one-word/index.md): One word about AI, found in six tries.
- [Five Moves](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/five-moves/index.md): A daily sorting game. Twenty cards, five moves of working with AI: Listen, Map, Build, Trust, Teach.

## Practices

- [The Walk-in](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/walk-in/index.md): Hold the people from your day.
- [The River](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/river/index.md): Set down what's heavy. Watch it go.
- [Lunar Life](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/lunar/index.md): The moon over your own weeks.

## Teaching

- [The Recipe Book](https://tools.dnsc.ai/recipes/index.md): Working systems for the AI you already have.
- [AI Gauges](https://tools.dnsc.ai/ai-gauges/index.md): Your own AI use: tokens, energy, water and carbon.
- [Games and practices](https://tools.dnsc.ai/well/index.md): Word games that teach AI, and the practices that hold the day. Some daily, some weekly.
- [The morning inbox · Recipe card](https://tools.dnsc.ai/recipes/morning-inbox/index.md): A recipe card: AI triages your inbox into three tiers, labels only, drafts the replies that need you, and sends a short digest. You still send every email.
- [Data centers on the ballot](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/data-centers-on-the-ballot/index.md): 46 data-center questions were on local ballots in ten states on November 3. Of the 44 with a count, voters took the side that limits data centers in 43. Ohio had 21 of the questions, in 18 places, and the limiting side won all 21. What a data center is and why a town votes on one; all 46 questions by state with the official count; Ohio's 21 in detail; the City of Trenton's Issue 17, the Supreme Court case that put it on the ballot, the annexation and the county moratorium; the four bills at the statehouse and the state's tax deal. Unofficial results.
- [HomeView · moved](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/homeview/index.md): 
- [Kroger's 3,000](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/kroger/index.md): On October 12, 2026 Kroger, the Cincinnati grocer with 2,697 supermarkets, told staff that about 3,000 of its 8,200 corporate jobs will be cut over three years. What Kroger is, what corporate means at a grocer, the memo, the company's AI plan for its app and stores, what it changes for shoppers, store workers, pharmacy customers and Cincinnati, from the record.
- [Eight States and OpenAI](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/openai-eight-states/index.md): On October 14, 2026, the attorneys general of Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia each sued OpenAI over ChatGPT in their own state courts. What ChatGPT is, what the states say, what each asks the courts for, how a chatbot learns to agree in OpenAI's own words, the timeline since 2024, and what has changed in the app, from the record.
- [School levies 2026](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/school-levies-2026/index.md): Eleven school tax questions were on ballots in Butler, Hamilton, Warren and Clermont counties on November 3, 2026. All six earned-income taxes failed; three of five property questions passed. What a mill is in dollars, what an earned-income tax is, every result on one board, Cincinnati Public's switch from an income tax to a 7-mill levy, what each district said it would cut or build, where each district's money comes from today, the state law that changed which levies are allowed, and what happens before the canvass closes November 24. From the record, November 2026. Results unofficial.
- [The task force](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/task-force/index.md): On September 30, 2026 the Secretary of War named Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to co-direct a 120-day study of future war. Who they are, what they build, what they hold and sell to the Department, what it means for Ohio, and what the study can and cannot decide.
- [The money in the air](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/the-money-in-the-air/index.md): How much money is being spent on Ohio's 2026 races for Senate, governor and the U.S. House, race by race, from the filings: the campaigns, the outside groups that paid for the ads, what kind of committee each is and who funds it, what the money bought, and what the disclosure rules leave out.
- [The table](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/the-table/index.md): What six companies and a President signed on September 29, 2026: the page in their words, the faces and what each one said after, what it binds, what it doesn't, and what would.
- [Who guards the pipes](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/who-guards-the-pipes/index.md): The Ohio Auditor of State's web server was attacked on Sunday, October 25, 2026, and the office that audits every local government in Ohio took its site offline. What the office has said, what it has not, the county that lost its own property search for days in 2024, the state's count of more than 150 local cyber incidents, the law that now requires a cyber program in every county and seals the record, what Ohio built before the attacks, the federal program that lost its funding, the vendors underneath, and what is and is not known about how attacks get in. From the record, October 2026.
- [Who owns the pipes](https://tools.dnsc.ai/civic/who-owns-the-pipes/index.md): Thirteen people and families hold the most votes behind the apps, networks and papers Americans use: who they are, everything they own, how many people each reaches, how a minority of the shares becomes control, and who owns local news across the country and in Butler County, Ohio, from the companies' own filings, October 2026.
- [HomeView](https://tools.dnsc.ai/stories/homeview/index.md): On October 13, 2026 Apple announced HomeView, a $299 home hub with a screen, a camera and Siri AI: what it does, how a home connects to it, what stays in the house and what leaves it, and a day with it.
- [PHP2Shell](https://tools.dnsc.ai/stories/php2shell/index.md): On October 21, 2026 PHP shipped fixes for two flaws, nicknamed PHP2Shell, that let anyone on the internet run commands on a website’s server without logging in. Cloudflare’s CEO posted that its network saw millions of attempts by that night. What PHP is, how the attack works, who went offline, what to ask your host, the 34 hours from leak to millions of attempts, and who found it with AI.
- [Two pledges](https://tools.dnsc.ai/stories/two-pledges/index.md): On October 18, 2026 Anthropic committed 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, subject to a stockholder vote. On October 19 Elon Musk posted that next year he will give one SpaceX share to every kid in America. What each pledge commits, who decides, what has to happen first, and what is not yet known.

## Optional

- [The Lakota Bond, Year by Year](https://tools.dnsc.ai/follow-the-money/v1-dustin/index.md): The first edition of the Lakota bond calculator, kept for the record. The current edition is Issue 2, in Plain Numbers.
